_about: svo-adapter tasks to RUN the SUBSIDE subsidence forecast end-to-end from upstream data. The forecast (run_spec ts-subside-forecast) has THREE SVO-typed inputs (water level = groundwater__hydraulic_head ft; storage coefficient = aquifer__storativity; land surface = land_surface__elevation ft) — all must be satisfied. planner.plan_model_run resolves each input from `sources` via its own conversion chain (head/elevation m->ft; storativity passes through) and converges them on the forecast run -> land_surface__subsidence + risk. standard_variable_uris are the catalog (w3id) ids the MINT model inputs carry, so contracts match the registered forecast. The run spec is also matched to the same StandardVariables MODFLOW produces, so a MODFLOW head output is a valid head source.

transform_specs.name: head-m-to-ft-msl
transform_specs.description: Convert a groundwater hydraulic-head raster from metres on the model datum to feet above mean sea level (m->ft + datum shift).

transform_specs.name: elevation-m-to-ft
transform_specs.description: Convert a land-surface elevation raster (DEM) from metres to feet above mean sea level.

transform_specs.name: subside-forecast
transform_specs.description: Run the SUBSIDE subsidence screening model (analysis.subsidence.forecast.run_forecast / POST /api/subside/forecast). Requires ALL THREE inputs; produces an annual land-subsidence projection + 0-10 risk. In-process/API model (no Tapis job).

sources.label: MODFLOW simulated hydraulic head (GeoTIFF)
sources.description: Hydraulic-head raster exported from a MODFLOW run (modflow6/usg/2000/96 'heads' output), metres on the model datum.

sources.label: Aquifer storativity (GeoTIFF)
sources.description: Aquifer storage coefficient raster (same property MODFLOW STO consumes), dimensionless.

sources.label: Land surface elevation DEM (GeoTIFF)
sources.description: Digital elevation model of the land surface, metres above mean sea level.
